research.title: Probability Calibration Under Class Imbalance
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to examine how class imbalance and calibration sample size affect predicted probabilities in binary classification.
Compared sigmoid and isotonic calibration using stratified splits, reliability diagrams, and bootstrap uncertainty estimates for Brier scores and log loss.

work.title: Order Processing and Inventory Coordination
bullets: Reviewed incoming orders for completeness, coordinated fulfillment schedules with warehouse staff, and maintained records of delivery changes and outstanding requests.
Reconciled shipment paperwork against inventory records, followed up on discrepancies, and prepared routine status summaries for daily operations meetings.

projects.title: Regularized Regression with Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented ridge and lasso regression experiments on synthetic datasets with correlated predictors, using cross validation to select regularization strengths.
Compared held out prediction error and coefficient stability across repeated data splits, documenting sensitivity to predictor correlation and observation noise.

projects.title: Gaussian Mixture Models for Overlapping Clusters
bullets: Implemented expectation maximization for Gaussian mixture models in NumPy, including covariance regularization and convergence checks based on changes in log likelihood.
Compared mixture models with k means on synthetic overlapping clusters, evaluating clustering agreement and sensitivity to initialization and covariance assumptions.
